purpose: Run a new exploratory external-target replication on DPP4 after HIVPR was declared externally unavailable, while preserving rather than replacing the original HIVPR record.
evidence_timing: Frozen after a public DUD-E target-table feasibility check and an RCSB entry-count query, but before DPP4 archive download, source-file inspection, coordinate retrieval, ligand allocation, docking, QUBO fitting, or enrichment evaluation.

provenance.hivpr_termination_reason: user-declared external unavailability after source audit and before receptor discovery or any HIVPR docking
provenance.replacement_status: new preregistered exploratory extension; not a silent substitution in the original three-target confirmatory gate

eligibility: at least 498 clustered DUD-E actives for the unchanged panel sizes
at least 17 RCSB X-ray entries before coordinate filtering
no required covalent, catalytic-metal, or specialized cofactor scoring
mechanistically distinct from the completed MAPK14 kinase study

considered_targets.decision: not selected because only ten active molecules remain beyond the required 498
not selected because another kinase adds less mechanistic independence

uniform_ligand_panel.split_group: Bemis-Murcko scaffold joined with duplicate source IDs before allocation
uniform_ligand_panel.disjointness: No internal ligand ID, source row, canonical SMILES, or Bemis-Murcko scaffold may cross train, fresh validation, or locked test.
uniform_ligand_panel.failure_action: Stop before receptor production docking if exact disjoint panel sizes cannot be constructed.

receptor_protocol_amendment.reason: The all-16 preselection gate caused technically complete EGFR and FA10 studies to terminate even though most receptors passed; DPP4 uses a prospective label-free oversampling gate.
receptor_protocol_amendment.coordinate_selection_data: coordinates and metadata only; activity labels and benchmark docking scores prohibited
receptor_protocol_amendment.pre_redocking_selection: deterministic max-min active-site geometry with the DUD-E reference included
receptor_protocol_amendment.post_redocking_final_selection: from all technically passing candidates, deterministically select 16 by max-min active-site geometry; no activity labels or benchmark scores
receptor_protocol_amendment.failure_action: If fewer than 16 of 24 candidates pass, report a DPP4 technical failure; do not add structures after seeing enrichment results.

frozen_production_protocol.score_aggregation: median across seeds per receptor-ligand pair; selected receptor subsets use min_score

frozen_qubo.retuning_policy: No DPP4-specific weight, target-size, aggregation, penalty, or BEDROC-alpha retuning is permitted.

comparators: matched linear Top-3 from the QUBO linear coefficients
random forest, XGBoost, gradient boosting trees, and logistic regression
all-receptor minimum, mean, and geometric consensus
interpretation_boundary: DPP4 can provide prospective exploratory evidence for workflow portability and QUBO behavior under an improved label-free technical gate. It cannot erase the HIVPR record, retroactively satisfy the original three-target confirmatory gate, establish quantum advantage, or establish experimental binding.
